name: Armor Industrial Fabricators, Inc
summary: Metal and plastic fabrication, precision machining and finishing from a 20,000 square foot shop on Interstate 10 in Baytown, Texas.

hero.eyebrow: Fabrication and machining in Baytown, Texas
hero.title: Need something cut, bent, sheared, drilled or welded?
hero.lead: With in-house machining, sandblast and paint, load testing and even urethane mold pouring, we have the equipment and experience to get your job done.
hero.imageAlt: A lineup of machined metal and plastic parts made at Armor's shop

groups.title: Fabrication
groups.summary: Full-service fabrication in metal and plastic, from structural steel to storage racks.
groups.intro: If it's metal or plastic, we can make it. Our staff is equipped to take on nearly any project including structural steel, piping, guardrail, storage racks, fixtures, shims, and much more. Contact us today for quotes or more information.
groups.imageAlt: Primed structural steel sections stacked outside the shop

services.title: Structural Steel and Plate
services.text: Structural work cut, fit and welded to your drawings, in the sizes and sections the job calls for.

services.title: Welding
services.text: Stick, MIG and TIG welding by certified welders working to qualified procedures.

services.title: Cutting and Forming
services.text: Cutting, punching, shearing and bending handled in house, so a part does not have to leave the building between steps.

services.title: Weld Procedures
services.text: We maintain weld procedures for multiple AWS and ASME specifications, with several procedures going through additional DNV certification. Our staff will work with you to ensure that all procedures meet your specifications.

services.title: Plastic Fabrication
services.text: Metal is not the only thing we build in. Plastic parts and assemblies are fabricated alongside the steel work.

groups.title: Machining
groups.summary: Turning, boring, milling, drilling and tapping, whether you have one part or thousands.
groups.intro: When it comes to turning, boring, milling, drilling and tapping - whether you have one part or thousands, our machining department is up to the challenge. We have experience working with a wide range of materials, anything from Teflon and Acrylic to Super Duplex Stainless Steel and Nickel alloys.
groups.imageAlt: A machined stainless steel fitting with a threaded bore

services.title: Turning and Boring
services.text: CNC and manual lathe work for round parts, bores and threads.

services.title: Milling
services.text: Vertical machining centers with the table size to take on large parts as well as small ones.
points: Haas VF9, 84 in x 40 in table, 36 in vertical
Haas VF4 with 4th axis rotary table

services.title: Drilling and Tapping
services.text: Holes drilled and threads tapped on the machines that cut the part, and on the manual presses for the simple jobs.
points: CNC rigid tapping in lathes and mills

services.title: Inspection
services.text: Parts are inspected to ensure compliance with customer specifications.

services.title: Industrial 3D Printing
services.text: Industrial 3D printing for projects large or small, easy or complicated, alongside the machine shop.

groups.title: Additional Services
groups.summary: Finishing, load testing, urethane molds and on-site installation under the same roof.
groups.intro: Here at Armor we believe in being a one-stop shop for our customers by providing additional services that help to improve lead time, quality and cost while simplifying your supply chain.
groups.imageAlt: Painted yellow and black steel posts finished in the shop

services.title: Sandblast and Paint
services.text: Blasting and coating with the capacity to take large parts, in the system and the color your specification calls for.

services.title: Load Testing
services.text: Lifting and structural items proof tested before they leave, using fixtures we build ourselves.

services.title: Urethane Molds
services.text: Urethane poured in house for rollers, pads and racks, so a part does not have to be sent out to a second vendor.

services.title: On-site Installation
services.text: Crews go out to the job to weld, drill, anchor and paint what the shop built.

about.title: Knowledgeable, experienced.
text: With decades of experience in fabrication and machining, there is not much that Armor's management team has not seen. Put our expertise to work for you to get your projects done right.
Armor's 20,000 square foot manufacturing facility sits along Interstate 10, just east of Houston, TX. This location provides unobstructed access to Houston highways and shipping ports.
Here at Armor we believe in being a one-stop shop for our customers by providing additional services that help to improve lead time, quality and cost while simplifying your supply chain.
